items.title: Honkai: Star Rail Officially Reveals $450 New Release
items.summary: Honkai: Star Rail officially reveals a new Razer gaming collection inspired by Silver Wolf LV.999, featuring a $450 release and more.
items.content:
Honkai: Star Rail is celebrating its 3rd Anniversary on April, 22, 2026, with the limited 5-Star character debuts of Silver Wolf LV.999 and Evanescia, and more. Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Honkai: Star Rail is officially releasing a brand-new gaming collection inspired by its resident intergalactic hardcore gamer, Silver Wolf. The new collection comes from Razer, following its recent partnerships with Wuthering Waves and Pokémon .

Razer and HoYoverse have officially unveiled four new Honkai: Star Rail gaming products, including a gaming chair, wireless keyboard, mouse and headset. The collection draws inspiration from Silver Wolf , particularly her LV.999 variant introduced in "Planarcadia," the nearly year-long storyline set to conclude this November . Among the new products is a Honkai: Star Rail gaming chair priced at $449.99. Additional product and pre-order details are available below.

Nobody reaches LV.999 by logging off early.

All Honkai: Star Rail x Razer products are now available for pre-order globally through Razer.com , excluding Canada. The collection will also be available soon at RazerStores and select retailers.

Honkai: Star Rail is available as a free-to-play game on PlayStation 5, PC and mobile devices (iOS and Android). HoYoverse describes the title as a space fantasy RPG in which players assume the role of the "Trailblazer," a "courageous individual implanted with a powerful artifact, Stellaron, and bearing the determination to unravel the mysteries surrounding the fabled 'Cancer of All Worlds' and Aeons."

Honkai: Star Rail stands out for integrating fantasy elements, myths and legends into an epic sci-fi adventure. The game also features a traditional turn-based combat system distinguished by its diverse roster of companions, alongside "immersive storylines that together compose an interstellar melody filled with captivating worlds, each brimming with unique cultures, awe-inspiring landscapes, and mythical wonders to explore."

She works as a freelance writer in the entertainment industry, focusing on video games, anime, and literature. Her published works can be found on Screen Rant, FinanceBuzz, She Reads, and She Writes. Sign in to your ScreenRant account Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Listen Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Razer is bringing another HoYoverse universe to gaming setups, this time with a collection inspired by Honkai: Star Rail . Following earlier collaborations built around Genshin Impact and Zenless Zone Zero , the hardware company is turning to Silver Wolf LV.999 for its next officially licensed lineup. The announcement expands a partnership that has already connected Razer peripherals with two major HoYoverse titles.

The Razer | Honkai: Star Rail Collection takes its visual direction from Silver Wolf, the self-assured hacker whose LV.999 persona channels the game's over-the-top gaming culture. Rather than introducing entirely new hardware categories, Razer is applying the character's aesthetic to four established products: a gaming chair, a compact keyboard, a wireless esports mouse, and a wireless headset, per a press release. Her LV.999 identity supplies the collection's main stunning visual theme.

That approach makes the release relevant to more than players looking to replace a single peripheral. The four-piece lineup gives Trailblazers a way to coordinate several parts of a gaming station, while the character artwork provides the crossover identity. Razer describes the collection as a meeting of Silver Wolf's competitive mindset and the company's performance-focused gaming design. The artwork extends across all four devices.

HoYoverse fans also receive an in-game incentive alongside the physical merchandise. Every purchase from the collection includes Honkai: Star Rail rewards, extending the collaboration beyond the desk and into the game itself. Razer has not detailed the specific contents of those rewards in the announcement, so buyers should check the official listing for redemption information. The bonus applies to each of the four products.

Razer's collection is also a continuation of its approach to bringing popular HoYoverse characters into the gaming hardware market. Previous collaborations with Genshin Impact and Zenless Zone Zero established a connection with those games' fan communities. Now, Silver Wolf's LV.999 identity gives the company another opportunity to combine recognizable character artwork with equipment designed for everyday gaming.

Close window.arrayOfGalleries["article-gallery-1-2056716645"] = '" Close "'; The lineup begins with the Razer Iskur V2 X NewGen – Honkai: Star Rail Edition, an ergonomic gaming chair intended to provide support during long sessions. It carries a $449.99 USD / €479.99 MSRP, making it the most expensive item in the collection. Its Silver Wolf treatment turns a substantial piece of gaming furniture into the lineup's centerpiece.

For players who prefer a compact desktop setup, the Razer BlackWidow V4 TKL HyperSpeed – Honkai: Star Rail Edition pairs a tenkeyless layout with Razer HyperSpeed Wireless connectivity and Razer Chroma RGB lighting. Its listed price is $199.99 USD / €219.99 MSRP. The smaller keyboard format leaves more room for mouse movement without giving up the wireless features emphasized in Razer's announcement.

Want shortcuts, macros, and gaming performance in one device? Meet Corsair's Nightsword V2 Wireless.

The Razer Viper V3 Pro SE – Honkai: Star Rail Edition is the collection's $119.99 USD / €129.99 wireless esports mouse. Razer highlights its lightweight construction, speed, precision, and control, positioning it for fast movements and competitive play. The Razer BlackShark V3 X HyperSpeed – Honkai: Star Rail Edition also costs $119.99 USD / €129.99 MSRP and brings wireless audio in a lightweight headset design.

The headset has the Honkai: Star Rail collection's most character-specific feature , powering it on triggers an exclusive startup voice line from Silver Wolf. All four products are listed for preorder through Razer.com in global markets, excluding Canada, with availability at RazerStores and select retailers planned for soon. U.S. MSRPs range from $119.99 to $449.99, giving fans several entry points into the collaboration.

items.title: Razer Powers Up Its Play With Honkai: Star Rail Collaboration
items.summary: Razer has teamed up with HoYoverse for another hardware collaboration, this time based on their popular gacha RPG, Honkai: Star Rail.
items.content:
Gaming Razer Powers Up Its Play With Honkai: Star Rail Collaboration Gacha Gear CGMagazine Follow Jordan Biordi Wed, November 11, 2026 at 4:00 PM UTC Wed, November 11, 2026 at 4:00 PM UTC *]:pointer-events-auto hidden md:block"> Razer Powers Up Its Play With Honkai Star Rail Collaberation - Photo: CGMagazine Since its launch in 2023, Honkai: Star Rail has captivated gamers with its interesting story and unique gacha-style gameplay. Now, Razer is partnering with HoYoverse for another exclusive line of gamer gear based on the RPG.

Announced via press release, following previous collaborations with Genshin Impact and Zenless Zone Zero , the Razer | Honkai: Star Rail Collection is inspired by Silver Wolf LV.999, the invincible player from the game. The gaming hardware, with her unmistakable aesthetic and competitive spirit, will be comprised of a premium gaming chair, mouse, keyboard and headset aptly named the "Ctrl + Alt + WIN" collection.

""From Genshin Impact to Zenless Zone Zero and now Honkai: Star Rail , this collaboration is a tribute to the communities that have made these worlds so beloved," said Global Head of Lifestyle Division at Razer, Addie Tan. She continued, "Silver Wolf's LV.999 mastery reflects Razer's ethos of performance-driven, cutting-edge design, and we're proud to bring her genius hacker style into the physical realm, giving players and fans a new way to experience the game beyond the screen."

According to the release, the Razer Iskur V2 X NewGen - Honkai: Star Rail Edition is built with long-lasting ergonomic support and all-day comfort for players who know every session is another chance to level up. The Razer BlackWidow V4 TKL HyperSpeed - Honkai: Star Rail Edition combines ultra-low-latency Razer HyperSpeed Wireless performance with a compact tenkeyless layout and Razer Chroma RGB for a keyboard that is responsive and ready for any game.

The Razer Viper V3 Pro SE - Honkai: Star Rail Edition was inspired by Silver Wolf's LV.999 gaming instincts; this ultra-lightweight wireless esports mouse delivers uncompromising speed and precision. The Razer BlackShark V3 X HyperSpeed - Honkai: Star Rail Edition is tournament-ready wireless audio with lightweight comfort; this headset gives players the competitive edge every match demands. What's more, every time players turn on their headset, they'll be greeted with an exclusive startup voice line from Silver Wolf.

The Razer Iskur V2 X NewGen will retail for $449.99 USD, the Razer BlackWidow V4 TKL HyperSpeed for $199.99 USD, while the Razer Viper V3 Pro S and the Razer BlackShark V3 X HyperSpeed will cost $119.99 USD, with every purchase also including Honkai: Star Rail in-game rewards. No release date was provided for this new collection; however, all items are available for pre-order globally (excluding Canada) on the official Razer website .

items.title: Razer Honkai: Star Rail Silver Wolf LV.999 Collection
items.summary: Razer and HoYoverse’s Honkai: Star Rail collection outfits a keyboard, mouse, headset and chair with Silver Wolf LV.999 artwork. Preorders open November 11.
items.content:
Razer and HoYoverse are following up their Genshin Impact and Zenless Zone Zero collaborations with a four-piece collection for Honkai: Star Rail . Silver Wolf LV.999 gets her own artwork across a keyboard, mouse, headset and gaming chair. The detail that caught my attention, though, is one you’ll hear the moment you turn on the headset. Razer gave Silver Wolf an exclusive startup voice line.

Having spent time with the Lucario edition of the BlackShark V3 X HyperSpeed , I’m especially interested in what Razer does with this one. The $119.99 wireless headset keeps the lightweight design I’m familiar with, and I like that Razer found a way to work Silver Wolf’s personality into something as routine as powering it on. That makes a lot of sense for a character who’s as much a gamer as the person wearing it.

On the desk, the BlackWidow V4 TKL HyperSpeed comes in at $199.99 with HyperSpeed wireless connectivity and Chroma RGB lighting. Razer went with a tenkeyless layout here, which leaves a little more room for the matching Viper V3 Pro SE . The Viper is an ultralight wireless esports mouse priced at $119.99. For anyone who plays Star Rail between rounds of a competitive shooter, that pairing has some practical appeal. You can keep the Silver Wolf setup and still have plenty of space for a wide mouse sweep.

The Iskur V2 X NewGen rounds out the collection at $449.99, bringing the same artwork to Razer’s ergonomic gaming chair. Each of the four items also comes with Honkai: Star Rail in-game rewards. Preorders open November 11 through Razer’s online store globally, excluding Canada, with RazerStores and select retailers to follow.

I’ll be getting my hands on the collection soon and will share my firsthand impressions here at G Style Magazine. The BlackShark is the one I’m reaching for first. I want to hear what Silver Wolf has to say.

items.title: Honkai: Star Rail Dev Explains Aha & Discusses Future Playable Aeons
items.summary: Aha might be just the start of what
items.content:
Honkai: Star Rail Dev Explains Aha & Discusses Future Playable Aeons From Screen Rant on November 9, 2026 | OpenCritic

Genshin Impact brought the world of HoYoverse games to a much larger audience than ever before, but Honkai: Star Rail was the game that proved the company's staying power. Several years later, Star Rail is still going strong, even after the launch of Zenless Zone Zero and the impending release of games like Petit Planet and Honkai: Nexus Anima .

At a HoYoverse press event in Seoul, ScreenRant sat down in a group interview with Honkai: Star Rail 's lead game designer Chengnan An to discuss the state of the game and future plans. Honkai: Star Rail 's introduction of the first playable Aeon, Aha, naturally came up in the conversation, and the developers offered some details about both Aha's development and the potential for future playable Aeons.

First, Chengnan An addressed the tricky subject of making an Aeon playable in combat without upsetting the balance. While power creep always tends to come into the conversation with ongoing live-service games, HoYoverse doesn't want to simply drop an Aeon into the mix and " overcome all the existing characters ." In Aha's case, focusing purely on destructive strength would also fail to " fit her personality as an Aeon of Elation ."
